name: Papra
short_desc: A minimalist document management and archiving tool.
author: papra-hq
description: Papra is a minimalist, open-source document management and archiving tool. Organize, tag, search, and archive your documents with OCR support, deduplication, and a clean modern interface.

form_fields.label: App Base URL
form_fields.hint: The base URL of your Papra instance (e.g. https://papra.example.com). Leave empty to use the default.

form_fields.label: Auth Secret
form_fields.hint: A secret for auth, at least 32 characters. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 48
